description: This file appears to be a Tcl script designed to perform a network sanity check by executing ping commands, parsing the output to assess packet loss and RTT, and preparing for automated checks.
external_methods: R (alias for a remote command execution)

methods.name: Run ping and check packet loss summary
methods.description: Executes a ping command to a specified endpoint and processes the output to extract packet loss and RTT information.

calls: R "ping -c 5 -w 7 1.1.1.1 | sed -E 's/([0-9]+)% packet loss/PL=\1%/g;s/avg\/.*\/[0-9\.]+/avg\/X.Y/g' | grep -E 'PL=|rtt min|round-trip' | head -n 2 | sort"
